title: LegacyHistoryService
responsibility: Reads imported legacy reports from the evidence branch for the history index and resolves their media.

inputs.name: LegacyHistoryService.constructor.root
inputs.description: The filesystem root passed to both EvidenceTreeAdapter and LfsAdapter during construction. It selects the repository data those adapters read; this implementation does not validate the path.

inputs.name: LegacyHistoryService.entries.media
inputs.description: The history media service used to place bytes and metadata for a legacy media item that has a sha256. Items without a sha256 are returned with media set to null and do not call this service.

outputs.name: LegacyHistoryService.entries
outputs.description: The resolved entries contain the latest schema-valid report for each record id, sorted by startedAt and then id, with linked commit information, a gap when unlinked, and media results. The result is empty when there is no evidence tip, and malformed reports are skipped.
